package paragraph

import (
	"context"
	"slices"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/dimen"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/linebreak/firstfit"
)

// FlowSeed retains the immutable initial result and the exact layout request.
// Only FlowStart initializes a seed; its zero value cannot be continued.
// Experimental methods share Prepared's serialized-use/stable-service contract.
type FlowSeed struct {
	prepared *Prepared
	request  LayoutRequest
	initial  *Result
}

// FlowCheckpoint is tied to one seed, preparation and ordinary line boundary.
type FlowCheckpoint struct {
	seed  *FlowSeed
	core  *khipu.FlowCheckpoint
	lines int
}

// FlowWork reports phase visits, not timing or allocations.
type FlowWork struct {
	khipu.FlowWork
	firstfit.FlowVisits
	AssembledLines int
}

func cloneFlowResult(r *Result) *Result {
	c := *r
	c.BreakPositions = slices.Clone(r.BreakPositions)
	c.BidiRuns = slices.Clone(r.BidiRuns)
	c.flowBreaks = slices.Clone(r.flowBreaks)
	return &c
}

func (s *FlowSeed) initialized() bool {
	return s != nil && s.prepared != nil && s.initial != nil
}

// Initial returns detached diagnostics sharing only immutable frozen geometry.
// A nil or uninitialized seed returns nil; a successful empty layout does not.
func (s *FlowSeed) Initial() *Result {
	if !s.initialized() {
		return nil
	}
	return cloneFlowResult(s.initial)
}

// FlowStart runs the ordinary initial layout once. NoHyphenation is an explicit
// admission gate, rather than a guess based on whether that run chose a hyphen.
func (p *Prepared) FlowStart(ctx context.Context, req LayoutRequest) (*FlowSeed, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		return nil, &Error{StageInput, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments}
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, &Error{StageInput, err}
	}
	if p == nil || p.owner == nil || p.content == nil {
		return nil, &Error{StageInput, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments}
	}
	if !p.content.FlowSupported(p.owner) {
		return nil, &Error{StageInput, khipu.ErrUnsupportedPolicy}
	}
	if req.Params.LineLayout != nil {
		req.Params.LineLayout = req.Params.LineLayout.Clone()
	}
	req.Atomics = slices.Clone(req.Atomics)
	if req.Horizontal != nil {
		h := *req.Horizontal
		req.Horizontal = &h
	}
	r, err := p.Layout(ctx, req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &FlowSeed{p, req, r}, nil
}

// Checkpoint captures a prefix of the initial successful complete path.
func (s *FlowSeed) Checkpoint(ctx context.Context, lines int) (*FlowCheckpoint, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		return nil, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !s.initialized() || lines < 0 || lines > len(s.initial.VList.Lines()) {
		return nil, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	cp, err := s.prepared.owner.FlowCheckpointFor(ctx, s.prepared.content, s.initial.flowBreaks[:lines])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &FlowCheckpoint{s, cp, lines}, nil
}

type flowWidths struct {
	prefix int
	a, b   dimen.DU
}

func (s flowWidths) LineLength(line int32) dimen.DU {
	if int(line) <= s.prefix {
		return s.a
	}
	return s.b
}

// FlowContinue keeps the whole source/bidi preparation, binds fresh planes and
// freezes a complete path. The suffix policy is explicitly first-fit even when
// the seed used Knuth-Plass. Geometry and paragraph-fill policy stay with the seed.
// All errors return zero work and no result; the checkpoint is reusable.
func (p *Prepared) FlowContinue(ctx context.Context, seed *FlowSeed, cp *FlowCheckpoint, width dimen.DU, resume bool) (*Result, FlowWork, error) {
	fail := func(stage Stage, err error) (*Result, FlowWork, error) { return nil, FlowWork{}, &Error{stage, err} }
	if ctx == nil {
		return fail(StageInput, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments)
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return fail(StageInput, err)
	}
	if p == nil || !seed.initialized() || seed.prepared != p || cp == nil || cp.seed != seed || width < 0 || width >= dimen.Fil {
		return fail(StageInput, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments)
	}
	prefix, err := p.owner.FlowPrefix(ctx, p.content, cp.core)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(StageInput, err)
	}
	if cp.lines == len(seed.initial.VList.Lines()) {
		return cloneFlowResult(seed.initial), FlowWork{}, nil
	}
	req := seed.request
	params, err := validateParams(req.Params, p.text, p.config)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(StageInput, err)
	}
	geometry := layoutGeometry(params, req.Horizontal)
	geometry.LineShape = flowWidths{cp.lines, params.Constraints.Width, width}
	boxes, advances, err := validateAtomics(ctx, p.anchors, req.Atomics)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(StageBind, err)
	}
	var work FlowWork
	end := -1
	if len(prefix) > 0 {
		end = prefix[len(prefix)-1]
	}
	ctx = khipu.FlowTraceContext(ctx, end, &work.FlowWork)
	bound, err := p.owner.BindParagraph(ctx, p.content, advances)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(StageBind, err)
	}
	breaks, visits, err := firstfit.FlowBreak(ctx, bound, geometry, prefix, resume)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(StageBreak, err)
	}
	result, err := flowFinishWithBreaks(ctx, p.owner, bound, params, geometry, p.text, p.config, p.runs, boxes, breaks)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, FlowWork{}, err
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return fail(StageAssemble, err)
	}
	work.FlowVisits = visits
	work.AssembledLines = len(result.VList.Lines())
	return result, work, nil
}
